notes: The frame's 'that' goes to the apodosis waw of וַהֲבִאוֹתִיךָ under rule 45's second clause, not to תִּהְיֶה — the contrasting treatment in vv. 10 and 18, where no apodosis waw stands, is correct on the same rule.
The suffix on הִקָּדְשִׁי is the infinitive's subject and takes 'I', leaving 'shall be sanctified' to the infinitive (rules 18, 52).
לְעֵינֵיהֶם is split rather than fused, since the ASV spends a word on each of 'before', 'eyes' and 'their'.
